messages:
maria: Hi team — starting Monday and I'm finishing security onboarding. Quick q: I'm traveling and might need to use my personal Mac (M1) for a few days before my company laptop arrives. Is there an exception process or temporary VPN-only policy? Also where do I enroll MFA? Thanks!
it-support: Welcome, @maria! Please avoid using personal devices for company work unless enrolled. We can issue a loaner. If you must use a personal device, we can do a temporary managed-device exception — open a ticket at https://internal.redwood.com/it/exception (subject: "Loaner request: Maria - expedite"). Enroll MFA here: https://auth.redwood.com/mfa. Ping me if you need overnight shipping.
security: @maria welcome! Short answers:
1) Phishing training is required before Prod access; check your invite (KnowBe4) — search spam.
2) Personal device is allowed only via BYOD onboarding (MDM + full-disk encryption). We rarely approve exceptions for product-facing roles.
3) VPN-only non-prod access can be granted temporarily. Open ticket and tag `security:device-exception`.
maria: Thanks — I can't install MDM on my personal laptop (privacy constraints). Loaner sounds best. If I open ticket now, what's ETA for the loaner?
it-support: Usually 2 business days. If you need it sooner, add "expedite" to the ticket subject and we'll do overnight shipping. Please include preferred shipping address and phone.
jamal: @it-support please expedite — maria is customer-facing on Tues. cc @security :pray: 
security: Noted. We'll approve VPN-only for non-prod until the loaner arrives. Please ensure MFA is enrolled and phishing training is started. Heads-up: there will be simulated phishing emails this week as part of onboarding.
maria: Where's the phishing sim FAQ? Do I need to report if I click a simulated phish?
devex-bot: Heads-up: onboarding checklist updated — https://go.redwood/onboarding/checklist. Phishing FAQ: https://go.redwood/phish-faq. If you click a sim, use the "Report Phish" button and notify security@redwood.com.
lisa: FWIW the MFA flow uses authenticator apps (we also support WebAuthn/hardware keys). Highly recommend registering a secondary method.
maria: Thanks, everyone — opening the ticket now and enrolling MFA. Will update once loaner ships :heart: 
it-support: Ticket created: #4527 — shipping expedited, ETA: next-day. DM if anything changes.
security: Confirmed: phishing training invite sent and exception route noted. Mark thread resolved after loaner receipt.
maria: Will do. Appreciate the fast responses! :thumbsup:
